description:
Instant file name and code content search for Windows developers.

DevFinder finds files by name instantly (reads the NTFS MFT) and searches inside code with an on-disk index.
It also searches Word / Excel / PowerPoint documents and Oracle Reports (.rdf) files, supports regex,
AND / OR / NOT queries, bulk replace with backup, Explorer context menu and Quick Switch for Open/Save dialogs.
- Search inside Oracle Reports (.rdf) files
